objective: Evaluate the frozen transparent spatial detector ranking against an independent actual-hydrogen open-ended-channel cohort.

source.title: Experimental Data of Hydrogen Dispersion in an Open-ended Rectangular Channel

cohort.selection_rule: Every locally present experiment archive whose filename matches 23_FFI_P101_T*.zip at protocol freeze.
cohort.exclusion_rule: Exclude only a file that fails publisher identity, cannot be parsed without ambiguity, lacks a monotonic time base, lacks finite per-sensor concentration values, or lacks an independently documented source/sensor coordinate frame. Report every exclusion and do not replace it.

endpoints.joint_rule: All primary screens must pass; secondary screens are reported for transfer diagnosis.

decision_rule.confirmatory_success: At least 10 eligible cases and both primary screens pass across the fixed cohort.
decision_rule.ineligible_result: Retain the data-access or metadata failure without claiming model failure.
decision_rule.negative_result: Retain the numerical negative result; do not tune or promote the candidate to runtime.
decision_rule.positive_result: A pass supports only bounded spatial-ranking transfer to this channel geometry and requires a separate runtime review.

claim_boundary: This protocol concerns actual-hydrogen concentration ordering in an open-ended rectangular channel. It cannot validate an outdoor station detector map, alarm or ESD setpoints, release magnitude, consequence distance, evacuation radius, station control, or SAGA effectiveness.
